reviews.comment: The rubrics are not very helpful. All it says is write an essay on this book? Everyone knows that but what is he looking for? God knows. Essays are graded very inconsistently and is more about formatting than the actual content. Very nice guy but lectures are boring, but you can't miss cause he will take off points. Final was really nice though.

3 papers and a final. Prof Rogers is very nice and obvs cares about what he's teaching. Reading is fairly light and easy. Funny prof and fairly interesting course make it a good humanities class if you have to take one.

Professor Rogers is amazing! He was so funny and his lectures were always super engaging. I looked forward to coming to each class, and felt comfortable enough to participate in class discussions which is pretty rare. I really wish I could have taken more classes with him!

I took Professor Rogers over 2022 Summer, and at first I was thinking it was going to be a very easy class. You will read a lot, but it is spaced out so it doesn't feel that bad. I absolutely would take this class again, he is an amazing teacher, and gives you great feedback on your papers. So if you are thinking about this prof, please do!
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Rogers was amazing. Zoom was hard this year but he made things so much easier. He encouraged participation and questions and when students were confused did not shame them but accurately answered the questions in a thorough way. The readings were interesting and often were the center of many funny suggestions. I strongly recommend him!
Had a great semester. Attendance is required but as long as you communicate with him youll be fine. Would take again!

Prof Rogers was awesome he made class very enjoyable especially since it was over zoom! He was very eager to hear what students thought about the assigned readings and he truly embodies the there is now such thing as a stupid question mentality. As long as you are willing to put the work in this class should be a breeze. Definitely recommend!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Professor Rogers was an amazing professor. You can tell he really cares about his students and if they learned the material. Always gave in-depth comments and ready to help. Would recommend.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Unclear on grading, there was no rubric provided for any of the essays and it felt like he just graded based on however it personally made him feel. 1 point off here 2 points off there.... you'll never know

Justin is so incredibly nice and really cares about what he is teaching. My class was Japanese based so we read Japanese poetry, watched Japanese movies, and read a book based in Japan. We had reading reflections due at the beginning of each class but they were super easy. I really enjoyed his class and would definitely take it again.

Justin was fun and light-hearted. I really enjoyed his class and he was very accessible in office hours. His classes were the highlights of my week. Not too difficult of a class, but took some time writing papers and reading the required text. One of the best profs I have ever had!!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Professor Rogers is very relaxed and definitely wants his students to enjoy the class and fully understand the material. If you put in the effort, I doubt you'll be disappointed.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: He is pretty relaxed. The papers are the big graded items, you just need time to do them. He is a stickler for attendance. Overall just fine.
